tiers.cache: setup-dotnet, setup-node and setup-gradle restore only dependency caches keyed by committed NuGet, pnpm and Gradle lock or verification inputs; global.json and exact native tool versions remain enforced, and build outputs/runtime state are not cached.
tiers.failure_policy: Any command failure blocks the merge candidate; no continue-on-error is allowed.
tiers.skip_policy: No skip may satisfy an active architecture, handoff, contract or V0.1-start gate.

tiers.cache: No mutable runtime sandbox is cached; future build caches must be keyed by the committed lock or verification file.
tiers.failure_policy: A failure blocks the affected platform; a missing required runner or platform skip leaves its release evidence open.
tiers.skip_policy: A platform skip is evidence of a missing gate, never a pass for that platform.

tiers.cache: Generated performance manifests and fault state are never restored from cache.
tiers.failure_policy: Scheduled profile regressions fail the run; an on-demand release-readiness check fails while any target gate is open.
tiers.skip_policy: Missing privileged, capacity, soak or platform evidence blocks the named release target; it is not auto-skipped.

future_native_gate_activation.dotnet: Active in V01-001: fixed SDK, locked restore, format, Release build, non-empty MSTest, vulnerability, license, duplicate-code, Roslyn complexity and sensitive-log gates run in fast-merge. Integration, contract and migration suites must join the same solution when their owning production tasks activate them.
future_native_gate_activation.typescript: Active for the generated AssetLink SDK in V01-002: exact Node.js 24 LTS, pnpm and TypeScript versions; frozen install, generator formatting/drift, lint, typecheck, Node unit tests, audit, license, size and sensitive-log gates run in fast-merge. Browser tests remain required when the first browser consumer activates.
future_native_gate_activation.android: The Kotlin/JVM AssetLink SDK activates fixed Kotlin, JDK and Gradle wrapper, dependency locking and verification, compile, SDK tests, license, size and sensitive-log gates in V01-002. The first Android app build must still add AGP/Compose lint, selected instrumentation and Android-specific vulnerability gates.
future_native_gate_activation.cpp: Production Shell activation remains blocked by M0-002 gates; its first approved build must add MSVC/CMake formatting/static analysis, ABI/export, forbidden-link, dependency vulnerability/license and fault tests.
future_native_gate_activation.database: Active in V01-003: the production manifest and PostgreSQL 16.15 job enforce forward migration, verified pre-migration backup, empty-database restore/replay, checksum drift, serialized ownership and least privilege. Business data access libraries remain owned by their first real infrastructure use case.
future_native_gate_activation.release_labs: Capacity, sudden-power-loss, administrator SCM, Docker hardening, Provider hard-sandbox and soak commands may be added only after their task names an approved runner, fixed sandbox boundary, cleanup and artifact retention policy.
